JavaScript · Polyfills

Write a polyfill for Array.prototype.reduce().

Answer

Array.prototype.myReduce = function (callback, initialValue) {
  if (typeof callback !== 'function') throw new TypeError(callback + ' is not a function');
  const arr = this;
  let i = 0;
  let acc;
  if (arguments.length >= 2) {
    acc = initialValue;
  } else {
    while (i < arr.length && !(i in arr)) i++;          // skip holes
    if (i >= arr.length) throw new TypeError('Reduce of empty array with no initial value');
    acc = arr[i++];
  }
  for (; i < arr.length; i++) {
    if (i in arr) acc = callback(acc, arr[i], i, arr);
  }
  return acc;
};
[1, 2, 3].myReduce((a, b) => a + b, 0); // 6

Key details: use arguments.length (so initialValue of undefined still counts), throw on empty array without initial value, callback gets (acc, cur, index, array).
